name: jwt_decoder
description: Decode a JWT (JSON Web Token) and inspect its header/payload, expiry status, and common misconfigurations (alg=none, missing exp, weak/guessable HS256 secrets if one is supplied). Does NOT verify a real signature unless a secret is explicitly provided — decoding a JWT never requires the secret, only verifying it does.

secret.description: Optional. If provided, attempts to verify an HS256 signature against this secret. Never required just to decode/inspect a token.
